gaps.title: Basic Combat & Auto-Attack Lifecycle
gaps.description: No human trace currently records hostile target selection, basic melee/ranged attack sequences, damage exchange, or combat state transitions.
gaps.suggested_action: Collect trace for basic melee combat against a stationary hostile mob (e.g., target -> engage -> attack -> defeat).

gaps.title: Direct Player-to-Player Trading
gaps.description: P2P trade window initialization, item placement, trade lock, and trade commitment have zero representation in the corpus.
gaps.suggested_action: Trace bilateral trade between two player characters with item & gold exchange.

gaps.title: Recipe Crafting & Production
gaps.description: Workstation interaction, recipe consumption, crafting progress bar, and crafted item insertion into inventory remain untraced.
gaps.suggested_action: Trace crafting a basic item at a carpentry/blacksmithing workbench.

gaps.title: Quest Acceptance, Objective Progression & Turn-In
gaps.description: NPC dialogue quest acceptance, objective tracker updates, and quest reward handoff have not been traced.
gaps.suggested_action: Trace picking up an introductory quest from an NPC, completing objective, and turning it in.

gaps.title: Consumable / Bag Item Activation
gaps.description: Client inventory item consumption (potions, food, quest items) exists in server code but has no trace corroboration.
gaps.suggested_action: Trace using a bread or potion from the player inventory bag.

gaps.title: Absence of Action-End Intent Markers & UI Dialog Hooks
gaps.description: Traces currently log /trace mark as instantaneous events without duration boundaries. Client-side UI dialog choices are only partially visible through network request packets.
gaps.suggested_action: Standardize '/trace mark start:<action>' and '/trace mark end:<action>' pairs to delimit complex interaction windows.
